adjudication.rationale: The findMembers function in group.js makes an async AJAX call and then sets properties (user_count, limit, offset, members) on the model when the response arrives. If a user rapidly clicks next/previous pagination buttons, multiple requests can be in flight simultaneously. Since there's no request cancellation, sequencing, or identity check, a slower earlier request could resolve after a faster later request, causing stale data to overwrite the current correct state. The diff shows the next/previous actions call findMembers() without any protection against this race condition.
